info.name: HR · Advance Requests (/api/advance-requests)
info.description:
Advance Requests (HR · Expense) — /api/advance-requests

HOW TO RUN
1. Collection variables: base_url, employee_email / employee_password, approver_email / approver_password (manager_email / manager_password only if the employee has a reporting manager).
2. 0. Auth → log in each role (tokens are stored automatically; every request already uses the right one).
3. Run folders 1 → 8 in order, or the whole collection in the Runner. Ids (self_advance_id, company_return_id, company_reimb_id, payment_id, return_index …) are passed along by the tests.
4. File fields (files[], proof, proofs[]) — pick any small PDF / JPG once per request in the Body tab (Postman can't ship files inside a collection).

ROLES
• Employee: raises, settles bills, records returns, raises reimbursement. Must be a linked employee, onboarding complete, already joined.
• Manager stage: the employee's reporting manager; if none, the branch admin (approver) acts as manager.
• Approver: hr.expense APPROVE rights — HR approve / reject, payouts, confirm returns, Zoho sync. No one can approve or pay their own advance.

FLOW
pending (manager) → manager approved → HR approved (locks deductions / additions → sanctioned amount) → payouts (partial → paid)
  • self    : recovered from salary (emi | lumpsum | bimonthly, from next month, instalment ≥ ₹500)
  • company : employee itemises bills → finalise → equal (done) | return (direct / payroll) | reimburse (raise expense)

{{today}} / {{next_month_start}} are set by the collection pre-request script.
Saved examples (Examples tab) were captured from the real API on local data inside a rolled-back transaction. 'Sync to Zoho' has no example — it calls Zoho Books.

exec: // {{today}} and {{next_month_start}} for requested_date / recovery_start (server rules: today; 1st of next month or later).
